text:
rachel: Heads-up — planning to onboard guidestar-v2 into the model catalog tomorrow during the 10:30-11:00 PT slot. Need a deployer, smoke checks, and rollback readiness. TL;DR: pin to slot-21, canary 5% for 30m, then full swap if green.
anya: I can take deploy ownership. Quick Q: does this need dedicated pools or fits into shared staging?
sam: Shared staging should be fine. guidestar-v2 is the quantized 8-bit variant; perf looks similar to current default. I'll run the preflight smoke and the eval set after canary.
rachel: @anya awesome — you + @sam then. @ravi please stand by for rollback ops if needed.
ravi: Oncall aware. If we see error spike or latency > 2x baseline we rollback. Who's owning metric gating?
sam: I'll drive the metrics dashboard and alerts during the window. Metrics to watch: p95 latency, error rate, token cost delta, and quality regressions on the small prompt set. I'll post the dashboard link when ready.
rachel: Checklist I'm expecting: 1) pin slot-21 reserved (done) 2) deploy canary 5% 3) run smoke script 4) watch metrics + manual eval 5) promote or rollback. Any missing?
anya: Add: confirm model alias mapping (guidestar:latest -> guidestar-v2) and update tokenizer artifacts path. Small script I ran locally:
```
# quick smoke
rictl run-smoke --model guidestar-v2 --prompts smoke/prompts.yml --workers 4
```
sam: copied smoke script into staging ops runbook. My smoke checklist (short): 
- curl health: `curl -sS https://staging.api.redwood/models/guidestar-v2/health`
- run 50 concurrent token streams (script above)
- verify no OOMs in GPU logs `/var/log/gpu-daemon.log`
- validate embedding similarity on anchor prompts
I'll comment in runbook with expected baselines.
deploy-bot: slot-21 reserved by rachel at 2026-03-18T18:20:12Z :white_check_mark:
rachel: Thanks bot. Can we get a time estimate for the smoke run? Sam?
sam: Smoke run ~8-10 minutes for the scripted 50 streams, manual eval + quality checks another 15-20. Total conservative: 40 minutes across canary+checks.
anya: Ok locking 10:30 PT. I'll start the canary, monitor for first 10m then hand to sam for deeper checks.
ravi: If we need immediate rollback: command is `rictl rollback --slot slot-21 --to-alias guidestar:prev`. I'll be ready.
sam: If all green at 11:10 I'll flip alias and start full promotion. Will post a short summary when done.
rachel: Awesome. Please react with :thumbsup: once you have pinned the slot and posted smoke output.
anya: pinned and starting canary in 5. :thumbsup:
sam: smoke run started. Past 3m — p95 210ms, errors 0. Posting logs in thread after 10m.
rachel: Great — thanks team. Postmortem prep: capture any anomalies in thread, no separate doc unless rollback happened.
anya: noted. pinging @eng-oncall in case we need live assistance.
sam: smoke done — small warning in one GPU host but it recovered, metrics stable. promoting now.
rachel: Promotion started. Will update when alias swap complete.
deploy-bot: alias guidestar:latest -> guidestar-v2 applied at 2026-03-18T18:56:01Z :rocket:
sam: all good from perf and quality side. No regressions on our eval set.
rachel: Closing loop — onboarding complete, slot freed for next. Thanks all :tada:
